    var result = checkPlugin("com.glide.hub.integration_hub", "com.glide.hub.integration_hub");

    if (!result.found) {
        var testGr = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_type");
        testGr.setLimit(1);
        testGr.query();
        if (testGr.isValid()) { result.found = true; result.table = "functional"; }

        return { status: "ready",
            actualValue: "Integration Hub is active | source: " + result.table,
            finding: "Integration Hub is active. AI Agents can leverage spokes for external system automation." };
    } else {
        return { status: "needs_attention",

        gaLegacy.query();

    }

    if (count >= 5) {
        return { status: "ready", actualValue: count + " active Integration Hub spokes",
            finding: count + " active spokes -- AI Agents have broad external automation capability." };

        return { status: "needs_attention", actualValue: count + " active Integration Hub spokes",

    }
